tools.name: set_objective
tools.description: Free. Turn one owner sentence into trust_weight, cost_weight, and max USD per call. Ambiguous sentences return needs_confirmation and do not overwrite a saved policy. The sentence itself is not stored. Requires the same API key as /mcp.

tools.name: rank_tools_for_task
tools.description: Rank 1-8 MCP candidates before paying any of them. Returns pick, fallbacks, and reasons. execute=caller: you call mcp_url and pay that server. A Down or stale probe is not callable. Sponsored does not change the score. With no own history, outcome_samples is 0 and the reason is INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: Free. After you call the pick, report success, latency_ms, and cost_usd. Only a recommendation_id issued to this API key is accepted. The next rank uses this key's history, not a public leaderboard.
